notes.title: Thank You for A Great My Lovely Empress Release Day!
notes.content:
May a thousand years of glory and praise rain upon your name, Your Majesty! 

In case you missed it my liege, My Lovely Empress is out now! 

We want thank everyone who took part in giving us such an amazing launch day. We're overjoyed that so many of you joined us in sowing death and destruction upon Ashuwa 🔥

We also want to say another [b]huge[/b] thank you for 95% positive reviews! If you haven't yet, here's a reminder to leave a review of your own, it really helps for the visibility of indie games like ours! 🖤

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052990/My_Lovely_Empress/#app_reviews_hash][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615942/6f0b685f66a21aed33ff650fe4a02a44884b67eb.png[/img][/url]

Finally, we are aware that there are currently some issues with the artbook for My Lovely Empress. We are currently working with Steam to fix this, and hopefully we'll be able to get the artbook into your libraries as soon as possible! 😄 

The Crimson Empire's glory is but a mirror of your own, Your Majesty. May your rule stretch to all of the continent, and your reign outlive humanity itself!

~ Neon Doctrine and GameChanger 👑

notes.title: Indonesian Language Update!
notes.content:
Hello to all our lovely Indonesian-speaking players,

My Lovely Wife has been fully translated into Indonesian, meaning you may now experience the summoning of succubi and incubi in your own language! 

[h3]To celebrate we've got a Daily Deal discount of [b] 50% off[/b] for you![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251930?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=juneDD&utm_medium=steam

[h3] 📰Other My Lovely News [/h3]
[u][b]My Lovely Daughters' rebirth into 4K is here![/b][/u]
My Lovely Daughter: Reborn Is Out Now, featuring a full art update to 4K! Witness the summonings and sacrifices of your homunculi in glorious high definition. Experience every drop of blood, every expression of betrayal... 

This upgrade is free for existing owners of the game, and as part of the Steam Daily Deal, it's [b]75% off [/b] to buy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/580170?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=juneDD&utm_medium=steam

[b][u]My Lovely Empress Demo Still Available[/u][/b]
Take your place on the Crimson throne while you still have the chance!
Get your taste of the third installment of the My Lovely Series in the My Lovely Empress Demo, available for only a little while longer! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052990?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=juneDD&utm_medium=steam

Without all of the incredible support for the My Lovely Series over the years, updates like these wouldn't be possible. We feel so lucky that your passion and excitement for our games allows us and GameChanger to continue doing what we all do. We are incredibly grateful to everyone who has enjoyed the series so far, and are looking forward to you all experiencing My Lovely Empress once it releases later this year. 

Now, go enjoy the perils of the My Lovely Family, and happy sacrificing! 

~ Neon Doctrine 🖤

notes.title: A Trilogy Of Offerings Are Coming...
notes.content:
Hello to all our wonderful My Lovely Series Players! 

Neon Doctrine and GameChanger have been gathering the materials for a special ritual, and it is almost ready. 

On the [b]23rd of June, at 10am PDT[/b] we will have a trilogy of incredible content to offer you while you wait for My Lovely Empress! Hold on to your wallets too, because we also have a [b]Steam Daily Deal[/b] for My Lovely Wife and My Lovely Daughter on update day. Get prepared for some pretty epic discounts on the 23rd. 💸

[h2]🔪My Lovely Daughter: ReBorn[/h2]
My Lovely Daughter is getting resurrected in 4K. [i]My Lovely Daughter: ReBorn[/i] will be a full update of the original game featuring all new artwork. and is a free upgrade for existing players! 

[previewyoutube=QM2GaTpuuPU;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/580170?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=juneDD&utm_medium=steam

[h2]💒My Lovely Wife[/h2]
My Lovely Wife is getting a new language added! To celebrate the continued growth of GameChanger and the Indonesian game industry, My Lovely Wife will be getting an Indonesian Language option!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37481570/a3f789e4b6879ca37dca23d7a4052866d696e5be.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251930?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=juneDD&utm_medium=steam

[h2]👑My Lovely Empress[/h2]
While it's predecessors are getting updates, our My Lovely Empress Demo will be available to play for one more week! So prepare yourselves for a taste of the latest installment in the My Lovely Series. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052990?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=juneDD&utm_medium=steam

We hope these promised offerings will be enough to summon your continued enthusiasm for the My Lovely Series, and we are looking forward to you all experiencing these updates on the 23rd of June! 

~ Neon Doctrine 💖

[url=https://discord.gg/nd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615942/ae722c0b337c54ba93f693c123684e2d591eb256.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Feast your eyes upon the UPDATED My Lovely Empress 3D Demo.
notes.content:
Greetings, 

The fated hour has arrived and Steam Next Fest is upon us. 

[h3]🚨 3D Demo Live Now! [/h3]
It's time for you to feast your eyes upon the UPDATED Demo of My Lovely Empress, featuring:
[list]
[*] All new 3D Animated Models
[*] New Yaoguai to unlock 
[*] New content to enjoy 
[*] Balancing updates, polishing, and bug fixes
[/list] Download and play the latest demo now to see the results of all the hard work of Neon Doctrine and GameChanger Studio!

[previewyoutube=u9RYZYxKkbo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🎥 Livestream[/h3]
On [b]June 10th, 7pm PDT,[/b] see GameChanger Studio's own Lovely Empress; CEO Riris, playing My Lovely Empress and discussing her involvement in the development of the game. 

[h3]💀A Challenge, If You Dare...[/h3]
Our dearest Emperor, we would like to propose a mission for you -  We believe My Lovely Empress deserves only the highest of accolades from its inclusion in Next Fest and desire its appearance on the most played demos list. 

So join us in playing the Demo throughout the week, and show the world the power of the Crimson Emperor. 

[h3]✍🏻 Feedback Please! [/h3]
Please leave us your feedback on the demo at this form: https://forms.gle/Q3uKPEzteEMHqF6b7

We value any and all feedback we receive, and those of you who provide us with meaningful responses will be recognized through a credit in the game! 

Now, your 3D Yaoguai await your orders my lord. 

~ Neon Doctrine 👑

notes.title: It’s time to get hot and bothered, Irresistible Incubus Update is Live!🥵
notes.content:
[h2]We invite you to embrace a world free from the chains of heteronormativity and say hello to some sizzling hot demon dudes.🌶️🌶️🌶️[/h2]


[previewyoutube=ngn1dfv69xo;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Now, with the Irresistible Incubus Update, witness a new chapter unfold. Our former "wife guy" protagonist, Jake, sets his sights on a different path, exploring the chilling depths of his desires. The gothic love story and treacherous affairs you adore remain, but this time, Jake finds himself bewitched by 20 tantalizing male-identifying demons. Prepare for spine-tingling scenarios and encounters with these charming yet monstrous creatures, who, despite their fearsome appearances, yearn for love.[/i]

Join us in this devilish dance of passion and embark on a journey that will leave you breathless. The gates to a world of seduction and darkness await you. [b][u]Unlock the "Irresistible Incubus Update" for My Lovely Wife now for FREE![/u][/b]

[u]As a bonus we also have the Daily Deal Discount running for the base game at 45%!🤘[/u]
